description: This file defines the EmployeeDecorator class, which provides additional methods and behavior to the Employee entity, including formatting dates, setting related entities by ID, and generating name strings. It acts as a decorator pattern to extend Employee functionality within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Employee entity, providing methods to retrieve and set employee attributes, format dates, and manage related entities through IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the decorator with an Employee instance.

methods.name: getJoinedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted join date of the employee.

methods.name: getDrivingLicenseExpiredDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted expiration date of the employee's driving license.

methods.name: getBirthday
methods.description: Returns the formatted birthday of the employee.

methods.name: getSmoker
methods.description: Indicates whether the employee is a smoker.

methods.name: setSmoker
methods.description: Sets the smoker status of the employee.

methods.name: setNationality
methods.description: Sets the nationality reference of the employee by ID.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns 'active' or 'terminated' based on the employee's termination record.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the first Location associated with the employee, if any.

methods.name: setLocationById
methods.description: Assigns a Location to the employee based on the provided ID.

methods.name: setJobTitleById
methods.description: Sets the employee's JobTitle reference by ID.

methods.name: setEmpStatusById
methods.description: Sets the employee's EmploymentStatus reference by ID.

methods.name: setJobCategoryById
methods.description: Sets the JobCategory reference for the employee by ID.

methods.name: setSubunitById
methods.description: Sets the Subunit (subdivision) for the employee by ID.

methods.name: getFirstAndLastNames
methods.description: Returns concatenated first and last names of the employee.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the employee, including middle name, concatenated.
